title: Notes Java Introduction To Pattern Programs 1

items.question: Write a Java program that prints a star immediately followed by an underscore.
Write a Java program that uses a for loop to print five stars followed by an underscore on the same line.
Write a Java program that uses a for loop to print five stars on the first line and an underscore on the second line.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print a square containing five rows and five stars in each row.
Write a Java program that uses a for loop to print the numbers from 1 to 5, followed by an underscore on the same line.
Write a Java program that uses a for loop to print the number 1 five times, followed by an underscore on the same line.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print five rows of numbers. Every row must contain the numbers from 1 to 5.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print an increasing right-angled triangle containing five rows.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print an increasing number triangle containing five rows.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print a decreasing number triangle containing five rows.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print a number triangle containing five rows.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print five rows.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print five rows.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print five rows. Every row must contain five underscores followed by five stars.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print five rows.
Write a Java program that uses nested for loops to print five rows.
